items.title: Turn Your Book Into an Audiobook in Minutes with Spotify for Authors
items.excerpt: Spotify expanded its ElevenLabs-powered Audiobook Creation Tools beyond beta to all US self-published authors: upload a manuscript, pick an AI narration voice, and publish a free, non-exclusive audiobook in minutes.

items.title: Feeling overwhelmed by the AI doom loop? Here's the essential reading list to make sense of it all
items.excerpt: Guardian reporters and experts recommend the books that explain how the AI industry got here and where it is headed, amid a chaotic moment reshaping our lives.
